limitations.note: The patch clocked only the ring register and left `data` combinational, so after each rising edge it showed the newly rotated bit rather than registering the pre-edge `q[5]`.
The test counted the sample before the first rising edge after reset release as bit zero, so it passed the combinational output instead of catching the one-cycle phase error.
